concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-industries-peak-season-refunds]] — 2026-09-15 seasonal guide to reserve advice, asynchronous ecommerce/POS and always-referenced omnichannel refunds, offline constraints, and direct-merchant versus platform payout timing; request or schedule is not bank-credit proof.
warnings: This source spans online, POS, omnichannel and payout topics while the existing adyen-refunds concept is online-focused; keep each channel's identifiers and outcome rules in the source rather than generalizing online behavior.
Refund reserve, delay, card checks and avoiding peak-season payout changes are provider recommendations, not blanket requirements or account-specific authorizations.
REFUND validation can precede later REFUND_FAILED; webhook outcome and payout schedule changes do not independently prove shopper or merchant bank credit.
